Upload queued records to Sia now.

USAGE
  sennit flush [flags]

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir       Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url    Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline        Work from this device only, without contacting the indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when     When to colour output: auto, always or never (default auto)
  --verbose        Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit flush
